Clear sapphire blue eyes. The navy collar has a subtle original wave seam; refined youthful simplicity, no maid apron or maid headband, no giant animal ears.

Petite normal anime anatomy about 5.5 to 6 heads tall, not toddler or SD chibi, not mature glamour proportions. The requested look is a CLASSIC MAID: deep cobalt/navy long-sleeved dress, restrained puffed shoulders, a modest fully opaque high round white collar, a small blue neck bow, a neat white ruffled headband, white shoulder frills, a fitted WHITE WAIST APRON over a softly gathered knee-above skirt, a tidy apron bow behind the waist, simple lace-edged cuffs, navy knee socks, dark blue mary jane shoes. Distinctive new ocean details: a very small original whale-tail barrette near one temple and a subtle wave embroidery along the apron hem. Straight glossy deep cobalt-blue hair flowing to the lower back, half tied back with small white ribbons, soft airy bangs and two delicate cheek-framing locks. No curls. Do not copy an existing DeepSeek-chan maid design: NO fin-shaped animal ears, no diamond pendant, no cleavage window, no corset, no off-shoulder design, no giant chest bow. Keep the costume a tasteful familiar traditional maid silhouette, not armor or sci-fi cosplay. Composition: 1024x1536 vertical, exactly ONE FULL BODY girl in perfect straight-on front view with upright un-tilted head, eyes looking directly toward viewer, both legs naturally straight, both shoes fully visible, arms relaxed slightly apart from body, both bare hands completely visible clear of the dress, five coherent fingers per hand, no objects. Clean almost-white pale blue background, flat soft even illumination, no scene, no inset portraits, no text or lettering, no watermark, no extra characters, no photorealism, no 3D plastic appearance. The image should feel refined, adorable and friendly with careful facial anatomy; make it original and immediately recognizable as the classic maid option of a blue-whale themed anime character lineup.

variants.label: E 经典 DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘·修正版
variants.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: revised E classic DeepSeek whale-girl maid concept for the user's local DaFeiYu avatar lineup. Reference image 1 is the actual publicly posted ZipZipPipe maid design based on 上善无形's whale girl; preserve its recognizable CHARACTER IDENTITY and costume language rather than substituting a generic blue-haired maid. Redraw as a refined, adorable Japanese anime young-adult heroine with slightly petite youthful proportions, about 5 to 5.5 heads tall, small soft oval face, luminous attentive blue-gradient eyes, delicate blush and a gentle lively smile. Not a mature glamour woman, not 3D, not an SD toddler. REQUIRED identity details: a single very large curved looping ahoge above the head; wide dark-blue cetacean FIN EARS with pale underside at the two sides of the head, attached anatomically, each with a small cyan bow; thick flowing very long hair that graduates from deep muted cobalt at the crown to light cyan-blue near the ends, arranged in soft loose LARGE WAVY LOCKS; one clearly visible thick dark-blue WHALE TAIL emerging from behind the lower back and curving to the side, ending in a broad two-lobed fluke. The tail must be a real continuous anatomical tail, not an embroidery or a disconnected prop. Costume: white frilled maid headband; deep navy maid dress with puffed long sleeves and frilled white cuffs; white pleated fully covered front bodice panel, small dark navy neck bow with pale gold edging and a small blue gemstone brooch; fitted dark navy waist with two rows of subtle gold buttons; white frilled apron with a visible small blue spouting-whale emblem near its lower part; a deep blue layered long skirt reaching the mid/lower calves, fine restrained pale-gold ocean-inspired edging along the hem and cuffs, white ruffled underskirt, opaque white stockings and navy mary jane shoes. Keep the chest fully covered and ordinary proportions; no chest cutout or erotic emphasis. Render 1024x1536 portrait with one FULL BODY character, straight-on frontal face and torso, head upright, eyes at viewer, arms relaxed slightly away from the torso, bare hands and all five fingers clearly visible, feet and all hair/tail ends inside frame with margin. Simple almost-white pale blue background matching the other DaFeiYu concepts, soft neutral even light, very fine clean anime linework, subtle high quality cel shading. No props, no text, no character sheet grid, no watermark. Preserve the distinctive loop ahoge, blue-to-cyan waves, whale-fin ears, large whale tail, and blue-white-gold frilled long-skirt maid silhouette from the reference. This is a reference-based redraw of a community character, not a claim to a new independently owned character.
